package clock

import (
	"fmt"
	"io/fs"
	"net/http"
	"sort"
	"time"
)

var Timeout = 3 * time.Second

func Direct(d time.Duration) string {
	return d.String()
}

func MethodValue(d time.Duration) string {
	format := d.String
	return format()
}

func ViaInterface(d time.Duration) string {
	var stringer fmt.Stringer = d
	return stringer.String()
}

func Boxed(d time.Duration) string {
	return fmt.Sprint(d, " ", d.Seconds())
}

func kind(value any) string {
	switch value.(type) {
	case time.Duration:
		return "duration"
	case int64:
		return "int64"
	}
	return "other"
}

func Kinds(d time.Duration, n int64) string {
	return kind(d) + "," + kind(n)
}

func Month(m int) string {
	return time.Month(m).String()
}

func Header(key, value string) string {
	header := http.Header{}
	header.Set(key, value)
	return header.Get(key)
}

func Sorted(values ...int) string {
	sorted := sort.IntSlice(values)
	sorted.Sort()
	return fmt.Sprint(sorted.Len(), sorted)
}

func Mode(mode uint32) string {
	return fs.FileMode(mode).String()
}
